tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa dus zhabs pa chen po'i zhal lung bzhugs so//

༄༅// gang gi yon tan rdo rje'i shugs// sgrib pa'i ra ba 'dral ye shes// nam mkha'i pha mthar 'phang mkhas pa'i// mthu stobs zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs gzugs kyis pad+ma'i 'dab rgyas thams cad skad kyis nyin mor byed// kun tu thugs kyi ye shes zla gang ma lus gcig pa lhan skyes kyi// dpal ldan dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo seng ge'i khrir// srid gsum gyis btud e waṃ gsung bar rtag tu bzhugs der phyag 'tshal lo// grol 'dod ku muta dga' gcugs kyis// 'dzum sa rgyu skar dkyil 'khor nyid// kha ba'i dum 'khrugs 'drar mdzad pa'i// dus zhabs ston ka'i lang tshor 'dod// mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas su dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa'i cho ga'i chings ni/ dus 'khor zhabs chen pos/ dngos grub yan lag bcu gnyis bsgom// bsrung dang kha sogs dag pa dang*// bdag nyid dag bya bdag bsrung dang*// tshogs gnyis bsags dang dkyil 'khor bskyed// byin gyis brlab dang dbang bskur dang*// phra mo thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*// mchod bstod rjes kyi bya ba'o// cho ga de dag re re yang*// cho ga dang ni ting 'dzin dang*// nga rgyal gzung ba gsum gsum mo// zhes pa'i dang po bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i yan lag ni/ tho rangs nam mkha'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i rol mos gnyid sad par bsam te thal mo sbyar sngags 'dis phyag bya'o// oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni na maḥkā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa mya/ de nas rnal 'byor gyi yo byad dag gis bstar te bde ba'i stan la kha shar du phyogs pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi zhing skyong rnams la grong gi ming ngam/ rang rang gi ming dang sngags 'dis gtor ma sbyin te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mu ka s+ya sa pa ri wā rā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gan+dhi puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ pra dī paṃ a kā taṃ da dā ma he/

sa pa ri wā rāḥshī ghaṃ a gats+tsha tu dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nān tu/ khā da tu/ pi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra kaḥsarba sa twā nā shīn+taṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣā/ ba ra ṇa gu pa taṃ ki ro tu/ i daṃ s+tha naṃ t+ya ka twā/ bā h+ye maṇ+ḍal bhū myaṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos te zhing skyong gshegs par bya'o// de nas rdo rje bzhis bdud kyi tshogs bsreg par bya ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje thugs su gyur pa'i dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥ snying gar sgra gcan la hūm̐/ lte bar dus me la hoḥ gtsug tor du nam mkha' la haṃ/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣaḥ phrag pa g.yon g.yas pa'i tshigs dang lag pa'i sor mo g.yon gyi mthe'u chung gi rtsa ba dang g.yas la mthe bong gi rtse mo nas bskor ba'i tshigs la/ nga ngi ngaṛ ngu ngl̥ ngaṃ*/ gha ghi gh-i ghu ghl̥ ghaṃ/ ga gi gṛ gu gl̥ gaṃ /kha khi khṛ khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kl̥ kaṃ dang*/ k+kā kakl̥̄ k+kū kakṝ k+kī k+kā/ kh+khā kh+khal̥̄ kh+khū khakhṝ kh+khī kh+khā/ g+gā gagl̥̄ g+gū gagṝ g+gī g+gā/ gh+ghā gh+ghal̥̄ gh+ghū ghagh+ṝ gh+ghī gh+ghā/ ng+ngā ng+ngal̥̄ ng+ngū ng+ngaṝ ng+ngī ng+ngā/ nye ba'i dpung pa dang sor mo'i bar tshigs g.yon g.yas la/ nya nyi nyaṛ nyu nyl̥ nyaṃ/ dzha dzhi dzhṛ dzhu dzhl̥ dzhaṃ/ dza dzi dzṛ dzu dzal̥ dzaṃ/ tsha tshi tshaṛ tshu tshl̥ tshaṃ/ tsa tsi tsaṛ tsu tsl̥ tsaṃ dang*/ ts+tsā ts+tsal̥̄ ts+tsū ts+tsarāṃ ts+tsī ts+tsāk+s+ya/ tsh+tshā tsh+tshal̥̄ tsh+tshū tsh+tshā+-i tsh+tshī tsh+tshā/ dz+dzā dz+dzal̥̄ dz+dzū dz+dzaṝ dz+dzī dz+dzā/ dzh+dzhā dzh+dzhal̥̄ dzh+dzhū dzhadzh+ṝ dzh+dzhī dzh+dzhā/ ny+nyā ny+nyal̥̄ ny+nyū ny+nyā+-i ny+nyī ny+nyā/ 'khrig ma'i dang sor tshigs rtse 'og g.yon g.yas la/ ṇa ṇi ṇaṛ ṇu ṇal̥ ṇaṃ/ ḍha ḍhi ḍh-i ḍhu ḍhal̥ ḍhaṃ/ ḍa ḍi ྜṛ ḍu ḍal̥ ḍaṃ/ ṭha ṭhi ṭhaṛ ṭhu ṭh-i ṭhaṃ/ ṭa ṭi ṭaṛ ṭu ṭal̥ ṭaṃ/

ṭ+ṭā ṭ+ṭal̥̄ ṭ+ṭū ṭ+ṭaṝ ṭ+ṭī ṭ+ṭā/ ṭhaṭhā ṭhaṭhal̥̄ ṭhaṭhū ṭhaṭhaṝ ṭhaṭhī ṭhaṭhā/ ḍ+ḍā ḍ+ḍal̥̄ ḍ+ḍū ḍ+ḍaṝ ḍ+ḍī ḍ+ḍā/ ḍh+ḍhā ḍh+ḍhal̥̄ ḍh+ḍhū ḍh+ḍhaṝ ḍh+ḍhī ḍh+ḍhā/ ṇ+ṇā ṇ+ṇal̥̄ ṇ+ṇū ṇ+ṇaṝ ṇ+ṇī ṇ+ṇā/ dpyi dang rkang sor g.yon g.yas kyi 'og dang rtse la/ ma mi mṛ mu m+laṃ maṃ/ bha bhi bhṛ bhu bhal̥ bhaṃ/ ba bi bṛ bu bl̥ baṃ/ pha phi phṛ phu phal̥ phaṃ/ pa pi pṛ pu pl̥ paṃ/ p+pā p+pal̥̄ p+pū p+paṝ p+pī p+pā/ phaphā phaphal̥̄ phaphū phaphaṝ phaphī phaphā/ b+bā b+bal̥̄ b+bū b+baṝ b+bī b+bā/ bhabhā bhabhal̥̄ bhabhū bhabh+ṝ bhabhī bhabhā/ m+mā m+mal̥̄ m+mū m+maṝ m+mī m+mā/ pus mo dang sor mo'i bar tshigs g.yon g.yas la/ na ni nṛ nu nal̥ naṃ/ dha dhi dhṛ dhu dhal dhaṃ/ da di dṛ du dal̥ daṃ/ tha thi thṛ thu thal̥ thaṃ/ ta ti tṛ tu tal̥ taṃ dang*/ t+tā t+tal̥̄ t+tū t+t+ṝ t+tī t+tā/ thathā thathal̥̄ thathū thathṝ thathī thathā/ d+dā d+dal̥̄ d+dū d+d+ṝ d+dī d+dā/ dhadhā dhadhal̥̄ dhadhū dhadh+ṝ dhadhī dhadhā/ n+nā n+nal̥̄ n+nū ྣnṝ n+nī n+nā/ long bu dang sor tshigs g.yon g.yas kyi rtse dang 'og la/ thaka thaka thakṛ thaku thakl̥ thakaṃ/ sha shi shṛ shu shl̥ shaṃ/ ṣa ṣi ṣaṛ ṣu ṣal̥ ṣaṃ/ ྊpa ྊpṛ ྊpu ྊpl̥ ྊpaṃ/ sa si sṛ su sl̥ saṃ/ s+sā s+sal̥̄ s+sū sasṝ s+sī s+sā/ ྊpaྊpā ྊpaྊpl̥̄ ྊpaྊpū ྊpaྊpṝ ྊpaྊpī ྊpaྊpā/ ṣ+ṣā ṣ+ṣal̥̄ ṣ+ṣū ṣ+ṣaṝ ṣ+ṣī ṣ+ṣā/ sh+shā sh+shal̥̄ sh+shū shashṝ sh+shī sh+shā/ th+kathakā th+kathakl̥̄ th+kathakū th+kathakṝ th+kathakī th+kathakā dang*/ rna ba/ sna/ mig gsum gyi g.yon g.yas/ lce dang lce'u chung*/ rdo rje dang gsang ba/ yid dang khu ba'i sgo rnams la rim pa bzhin/ a ā/ e ai/ a ra ār/ o au/ al āl/ aṃ aḥgatsug tor dang mgo lce dang rkan/ lag pa rkang pa'i mthil/ bshang lam gsum gyi g.yon g.yas su/ ha hā/ ya yā/ ra rā/ wa wā/ la lā/ de rnams yongs su gyur la las 'khor lo drug tu rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang so gsum pa dang dgu pa dang re lnga pa dang lnga pa dang so gsum pa rim pa bzhin dkar dmar nag ser ljang sngo ba/

bya ba'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis la rtse mo so gcig par/ las kyi 'khor lo drug cu la rdo rje rtse mo bdun pa re/ dbang po rnams la rtse mo gsum pa re/ las dbang rnams la rtse mo lnga pa re/ rim pa bzhin ljang nag dmar dkar ser sngo ba 'khod pas rdo rje'i lus su gyur/ de nas bgegs la bka' bsgo ba/ hūm̐/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus 'di yis// sku gsum las byung 'gas par bya// gal te dam tshig las 'das na// zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// rdo rje 'bar ba bde chen po// ye shes 'byung ba'i las rtsom gyi// brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs// gnas 'dir ma gnas gzhan du dengs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥr ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarbā wa ra ṇa/ dharma pra la ya/ swa bhā wa/ sarba mā rakā yi ka bigh+na bi nā ya ka dī nāṃ/ da sha dig+ga tā nāṃ/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha smi ku ru ku ru huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod cing rdo rje de rnams las rang rang gi kha dog can gyi me rab tu 'bar ba 'phros te/ steng du ljang khu/ 'og tu sngon po/ shar dang shar lho gnag lho dang lho nub dmar/ byang dang byang shar dkar/ nub dang nub byang ser ba rnams kyis phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud kyi tshogs sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs nas thal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ reḥbadz+ra tsan+d+ra sūr+ya rā hu kā la ag+na yaḥkā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra prā kā rā na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ nam mkha' dang sa 'byar ba zlum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par snang ba nas sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ra ba'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi yul 'khor gyi mthar thug pa/ thams cad du 'og tu mdung rnams dang steng du mda'i drwa ba sngon po/

phyi rol tu me dpung gi ra ba/ oṃ hāṃ yāṃ rāṃ bāṃ lāṃ badz+rā kā sha bā yu te dza ud ka pṛ thig wī badz+ra swa bhā wa pañtsa dhā ta bo badz+ra man+ḍa lā ni ku ru ku ru swāhā/ hāṃ las nam mkha'/ yāṃ las rlung*/ rāṃ las me/ bāṃ las chu/ lāṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi steng dang 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha sbyar gyis brgyan pa rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las oṃ huṃ bi shwa kā ya badz+ra kū ṭā gā raṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ ra ba gsum dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang srid dang rgyar khru nyis brgya pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa khru bcu gnyis pa/ mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte ba khru bzhi pa/ oṃ paḥbi shwa badz+ra pad+ma ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya badz+ra sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ lte ba dang tshad mnyam pa'i pad nyi/ khang brtsegs kyi nang gi steng 'og rtsibs rnams su nyi ma/ thugs kyi ra ba'i nang*/ gsung gi ra ba'i phyi/ sku ra ba'i phyi nang du stong pa rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung gi ra ba'i nang la ngang pa dang*/ mkha' lding*/ yi dwags dang ri dwags/ ma he dang lug chu srin dang khyu mchog glang po che dang gzhal yas khang gi gdan rnams steng dang 'og shar dang me/ lho dang bden bral/ byang dang dbang ldan/ nub dang rlung rnams su rim pa bzhin 'khod pa/ oṃ huṃ kro dha na dro haṃ kro dhā nāṃ/ ā dz+nyā dā ya ka swā hā/ lte bar rang nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po nag dmar dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ re re'ang mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ spyan gsum gsum ser skyar 'dug pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phag pa mdun nas nag dmar dkar ba gsum re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i dpung pa drug drug de las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i phyag bcu gnyis bcu gnyis rang rang dang mdog mtshungs pa/

phyag thams cad kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste sor gdub rnams kyis mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje/ gnyis par ral gri/ gsum par rtse gsum/ bzhi par gri gug dmar po bzhi'i dang por me'i mda'/ gnyis par rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ bzhi par tho ba/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por 'khor lo/ gnyis par mdung*/ gsum par dbyug pa/ bzhi par dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje dril bu/ gnyis par phub/ gsum par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnam par rgyas pa/ bzhi par khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gsum par rin po che/ bzhi par pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por mdung*/ gnyis par me long*/ gsum par rdo rje lcags sgrog bzhi par tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas spras pa 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma gnyis g.yas gnag g.yon ser ba/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag g.yon pa gnyis nas gzung ste 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa/ bdud 'dod lha dang nyon mongs pa dbang phyug gi snying ga g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis mnan pa/ mi rus las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rgyan drug dbu re re la thod pa rdzogs pa kha dog lnga'i 'phreng ba 'chang ba/ klu'i dbang po bcus brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ de'i snying gar nyi ma la rim pa bzhin gyi ye shes kyi sa bon/ oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā uṣ+ṇi ṣa ūr dh+wa di shi ra k+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ sa bon de yongs su gyur pa las/ gtsug tor can ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje dang gri gug dang dgra sta/

g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang thod pa dang tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ oṃ hāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza sum+bha a dho di shi ra k+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gnod mdzes sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje dang gri gug dang dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang thod pa dang tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste khang rtsegs kyi steng 'og tu/ oṃ yaṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti ba la sarba bigh+nān+ta ka pūrba di shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ bgegs mthar byed nag po g.yas skor gyi nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri dang*/ gri gug dang*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon na phub dang thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ oṃ yaḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza mā la daṇ+ḍa āg+na y+yāṃ di shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dbyug sngon can nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa/ sna g.yon/ g.yas nas shar dang mer/ oṃ raṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza dzam+bha ka duṣ+ṭa pra dz+nyān+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa de shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ shes rab mthar byed dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na me'i mda' dang*/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon na gzhu dang rdo rje'i zhags pa dang*/ rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ rāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki ni ri t+yaṃ da shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ 'dod rgyas dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa gnyis mig g.yon g.yas nas lho dang bden bral du/ oṃ baṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+man+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ pad+ma mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na tho ba dang*/ mdung dang rtse gsum/

g.yon na pad dkar 'dab ma brgya pa dang*/ me long dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ a wāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la i shā na de rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ mi g.yo ba dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na tho ba dang mdung*/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang me long 'dzin pa/ lce dang chu lam nas byang dang dbang ldan du/ oṃ lam badz+ra kro dha rā dza stam+bha ka ya mān+ta ka paṣatsi ma di shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gshin rje mthar byed ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ 'jigs byed rdo rje/ g.yon na dung dang*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ lāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā ba la bā ya byāṃ di shi rak+ṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ stobs po che ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis na mdung dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ bshang lam dang rdo rje gtsug tor nas nub dang rlung du thams cad kyang skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa rang rigs cod pan can/ sbrul dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa gdong re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ ye shes dag pas khang rtsegs kyi nang bsrung ba/ nga ngā nyi nyī ṇṛ ṇṛ' mu mū nal̥ nal̥̄/ rim pa bzhin zad par nam mkha'i gnyis/ rlung gnyis/ me gnyis/ chu gnyis/ sa gnyis/ phyogs kyi mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug 'dzin pa/ lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sngar gyi go rim bzhin phyung ste khang brtsegs kyi phyi thugs kyi ra ba'i nang gi gdan rnams la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa yid kyi khams bsrung ba/ gha ghā dzhi dzhī ḍh-i ḍhā+-i bhu bhū dhali ngahl̥̄/ tshangs pa ljang khu zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na khab dang bgrang 'phreng*/

g.yon na pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ khyab 'jug sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo dang dbyug tho/ g.yon na pad+ma dang skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa/ bden bral nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na ral gri dang gri gug g.yon na phub dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung lha nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du me tog g.yon na in+d+ra nī la dang ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ gshin rje dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon na lcags sgrog dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ me lha dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na shak+ti dang dbyug pa/ g.yon na pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgya mtsho dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na zhags pa dang rin po che/ g.yon na sbrul zhags dang zla ba chu shel 'dzin pa/ drag po dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rtse gsum dang mda'/ g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga sbrul dang bcas pa'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ dbang po ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang me'i mda'/ g.yon na dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rin po che dang be con/ g.yon na ne'u le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ go rim bzhin phyung ste gsung gi rwa ba'i nang gi gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ga gā dzi dzī ྜṛ ྜṝ bu bū dal̥ dal̥.ā/ sgra gcan ljang khu dang dus me sngon po/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon na dril bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba nag po phyag g.yas na gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ nyi ma nag po phyag g.yas na ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon na phub dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ lhag pa dmar po phyag g.yas na mda' dang rin po che/ g.yon na gzhu dang me long 'dzin pa/ mig dmar dmar po phyag g.yas na rdo rje lcags kyu dang rin po che/

g.yon na rdo rje zhags pa dang me long 'dzin pa/ pa sangs dkar po phyag g.yas na pad+ma dang shel 'phreng*/ g.yon na spyi blugs dang dung 'dzin pa/ phur bu dkar po phyag g.yas na 'khor lo dang mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ g.yon na pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ mjug ring ser po phyag g.yas na sbrul zhags dang dbyug pa/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang tho ba 'dzin pa/ spen pa ser po phyag g.yas na lcags sgrog dang tho ba/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang rdo rje phur bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ bu ga nas go rim bzhin phyung nas gsung gi ra ba'i phyi'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa de gnyis ngag gi khams bsrung ba/ kha khī tshi tshī ṣaṛ ṣaṝ phu phū thal̥ thal̥̄/ rgyal ba ljang khu dang rnam rgyal sngon po sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can/ stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag po/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po/ pad+ma chen po dang 'jog po ser po thams cad sbrul mgo lnga pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon na pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ go rim bzhin byung nas sku ra ba'i nang gi gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ka kā tsi tsī ṭaṛ ྚṝ pu pū tal̥ tal̥̄/ ro langs ljang khu dang*/ grul bum sngon po/ mi'am ci khyi gdong can dang*/ skyes bu'am ci bya rog gdong can nag po/ dri za phag gdong can dang*/ 'byung po bya rgod gdong can dmar ba/ srin po stag gdong can dang*/ yi dwags 'ug gdong can dkar po/ brjed byed ce spyang gi gdong can dang mkha' lding gi gdong can ser mo/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ go rim bzhin phyung ste sku'i rwa ba'i phyi'i gdan la zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa/

de gnyis lus kyi khams bsrung ba'o// sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣāṃ tsakra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nga rgyal gzung bar bya'o// 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhin gyi gtor ma sbyin nas/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i haṃ la khro bo/ gtsug tor gyi aṃ la zad par/ dpral bar i la phyogs skyong*/ mgrin par ṛ la gza'/ snying gar u la klu/ ste bar l̥ la 'byung po'i 'khor lo thim/ gnyis pa kha la sogs pa dag par bya ba'i yan lag ni bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang yaṃ raṃ kaṃ rim pa bzhin yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi khar thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ lag pa g.yon pa'i thal mo bkab ste/ a oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dhaḥswa bhā wa sarba dharmā na bi shod+dha ya swā hā/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/ g.yas pa bkab ste/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma pra bo bha ka sarba dharmā na pra bo dha ya swā hā/ mang por spel/ thal mo gnyis kha sbub nas bkab ste/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dhārma pra dhi pa ka sa ya swāhā/ kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'bar ba/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ hoḥsarba dhar+m+ma badz+rā mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā na badz+ra mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ bdud rtsir zhu/ rang nyid kyi lce rtser hūm̐ las rdo rje sbu gu can des bdud rtsi drangs par bsam zhing myang ngo*// gtsug tor gyi steng du baṃ las zla ba la rdo rje baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni pra ṇa ya mi swāhā/ de zhu ba'i rgyun gyis gtsug tor nas brtsams te rkang pa'i sen mo'i mtha' ji srid pa'i rang gi lus sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa bzhin du lan gsum dor bas dri ma med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur te zhi rgyas la'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥpradz+nyā+o pā yā dam ka kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa te ma ma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+raṃ badz+rā mṛ taṃ swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru skan+dhā twa ya ta naṃ niḥswa bhā waṃ swā hā/

de nas dag pa'i nga rgyal bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gsum pa bdag dag par bya ba'i yan lag ni/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas par skad cig gis gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po las 'od dpag med dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las rin 'byung dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ snying gar hūm̐ nag po las don grub nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ lte bar hoḥser po las rnam snang ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥsngon po las rdor sems sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ oṃ hriḥsarbā s+t+ra rā dza mā ra kle shan+ta ka ra/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ra duḥkha ts+tshe dam ma ka raṃ bi sho dha ya swāhā/ 'dis phan tshun du lag pas lag pa mnye bar bya'o// lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi rtsa bar rtse mo'i tshigs bco lnga la rim pa bzhin/ a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas rim pa bzhin gyis rtse mo bar rtsa ba'i tshigs la/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ā ra ai ā/ li ū ṝ ī ā/ lag pa gnyis kha sbyar ba'i dbus hūm̐ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar ba'i mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar bya/ gung gnyis mnyam du brkyang ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis phyed 'khyog pa'i tshul du bzhag ming med 'og tu bskum pa rang gi lag mthil du son pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcing des spyi bo nas rkang sen gyi bar gyi yan lag thams cad la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho k+ṣaḥkā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+raṃ badz+ra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kā ya swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ nga rgyal gzung ngo*// bzhi pa go cha'i yan lag ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis kyis snying ga sogs su reg cing*/ oṃ hral̥̄ṃhri da yā ya na maḥmago bor oṃ huṃ si ra se swāhā/ gtsug tor la/ oṃ hraṝṃ shi khā yai bau ṣa ṭa/ yan lag thams cad la/ oṃ hrīṃ ka ba tsā ya hūm̐/ mig la/ oṃ hrāṃ na trā ya wa ṣa ṭa/ dge ba la g.yon pa dang*/ mi dge ba la g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi se gol gyis phyogs thams cad du mtshon cha dgod cing*/ oṃ hrāḥ.a s+t+rā ya phaṭ ces brjod/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya si raḥshi khā ka pa tsa ne tra as+t+ra badz+ra ṣa ḍaṃ ga sa swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nga rgyal gzung*/ lnga pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga de las nyi ma bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu sad par byed pa'i 'od zer rnams nam mkha'i khams su spros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar log pa las zla ba la ye shes kyi sa bon de rnams yongs su gyur pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bya ste/ oṃ ts+tshadz+dzah+nya badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha a+rats+tsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ts+tshadz+dzah+nyā badz+ra mā le mā la a+rats+tsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྚṭhaḍ+ḍah+ṇa badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa a+rats+tsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ ྚṭhaḍ+ḍah+ṇā badz+ra pra ngī pe pra ngī pa a+rats+tsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ paphab+bh+ma badz+ra a mṛ te nai bed+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ paphababh+mā badz+ra ak+ṣa ta ak+ṣa ta pha la a+rats+tsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ t+thad+dh+na badz+ra lā sā wa s+t+ra/ sā bha ra ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ t+thad+dh+nā
badz+ra hā s+ye ghaṇ+ṭa ā dar+sha pū dzā ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ k+khag+ghang badz+ra wa d+ye wa d+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ k+khag+ghangā

badz+ra nṛ t+ye nṛ t+ye pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā tā/ oṃ saྊp+ṣ+shaྈྐ badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ saྊp+ṣ+shaྈྐཱ badz+ra pa me sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa nā kro dhā ngī nāṃ/ badz+ra su ra ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas nas sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags byas te// sgrub pa po yi lus dang ngag dang sems rnams dag pa yis ni gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar byas// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnams mang dge ba gang byas pa// de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnams bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pa rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do// bsod rnams kyi tshogs so// de nas 'di bsgom ste/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad ni// dngos dang bral bas stong pa nyid// rgyu las 'das pas mtshan ma med// 'bras bu med pas smon pa med// skye 'gag med pas 'dus ma byas// oṃ shrūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a na bhi saṃ skā ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ tshogs kyi zhing bdag nyid la thim zhing bdag nyid thugs ka'i zla ba rdo rje dang*/ bcas pa me long gi dbugs ltar 'du rim gyis thim nas khams drug gi dwangs ma kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa pra se na lta bur gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nga rgyal gzung*/ drug pa dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i yan lag ni stong pa nyid kyi ngang las sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzhi rwa gur dang bcas pa'i nang du ྷk+ṣam+lawar+yam̐ rnam pa bcu'i sa bon rim pa bzhin yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung gi nang 'og nas rim pa bzhin rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa

dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum bkra shis kyis mtshan pa 'bum phrag gsum pa/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po pad+mas mtshan pa 'bum phrag gnyis pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi 'khor los mtshan pa dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa/ bzhi ka'i steng 'og tu hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram re re/ lhun po chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang*/ steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma ri rab phyed dang mnyam pa sum cha lte ba la yod cing*/ lte ba'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po nyi ma dang mnyam pa'i khar oṃ yongs su gyur pa las sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nor bu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi nas rim pa bzhin ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nag dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa gsum dang ldan pa/ gsum ka'ang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa gser gyi rang bzhin gyi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rta babs so so la ka ba bzhi'i bar du lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i brtsegs ma gsum pa/ brtsegs ma 'og ma la glang po che'i mgor seng ges mnan pa dang*/ bar ma dang steng ma shā la bhañdzi kas snam bu bteg pa/ snam bu so so'i rtse mor rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ me long dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ba dan dkar po rnams 'phyang ba/ steng du ha rmig dang*/ de'i steng du dbus su bum pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang*/ ka ba'i bsham nas myos pa bsrung bas bskor ba'o// sku'i rta babs kyi brtsegs ma 'og ma'i shar du chos 'khor nag po/

g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo/ lhor bum pa bzang po dmar po/ g.yas g.yon du dung dang pad+ma/ byang du rnga bo che dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu byang chub kyi shing ser po/ g.yas g.yon du mi'am ci pho mo'o// rtsig pa so so'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po rin po che'i mching ba rnam par bkra ba/ de'i steng du do shal dang do shal phyed pa/ me long dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ ril bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ me tog gi 'phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku lā dkar po/ de'i steng du kra ma shrir+ṣa'i mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ phyir 'dod yon gyi snam bu dkar pos 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor zhing*/ sgo khyud dang ka ba'i mtshams su rin po ches spras pa/ zur bzhi sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i nang du rtsig pa la ma reg pa'i snam bu dkar po steng gi thog dang bcas pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo rdo rje 'phreng ba ljang khus bskor zhing shar du ral gri nag po/ lhor rin po che dmar po/ byang du pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu 'khor lo ser po spras pa'i ka ba nag po bcu drug dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi rdo rje'i 'phreng ba nag pos bskor ba'i gtso bo'i pad+ma ljang khu/ gsung gi snam bu la gdan so so'i steng du pad+ma dkar po'i mu khyud can gyi pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa brgyad/ sku'i snam bu la gdan so so'i steng du 'khor lo'i mu khyud can gyi pad+ma bzhi dang brgyad/ bcu drug gi 'dab ma gsum rim can steng 'og dang sgor shing rta/ rta babs kyi 'og tu 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod du gdan so so'i steng du 'khor lo/ phyi rol du mchod pa'i sa la pad+ma bum sogs mchod rdzas du mas gang ba/

gzhal yas khang gi gzhi dang steng 'og thams cad kyi dbus sngon po/ shar nag lho dmar/ byang dkar/ nub ser ba/ phyi nas sa chu me rlung gi khor yug bzhis bskor ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gling bcu gnyis/ de'i dbang ldan gyi mtshams su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bden bral gyi mtshams su āḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ me dang rlung gi dbus su dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nam mkha'i khor yug la rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu 'od zer 'bar bas bskor ba/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a i ṛ u l̥ a e ar o a la/ ha ya ra wa la/ aṃ rnams g.yon skor/ lā wā rā yā hā/ ā la au ā ra ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā aḥrnams g.yas skor/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo de rnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor des mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i 'og g.yas skor du/ l+la w+wa y+ya ḍ+ḍa dhadha l+la w+wa ḍ+ḍa y+ya ྷྷ/ s+sa ny+pany+pa ṣ+ṣa sh+sha ྈྐྈྐ/ t+ta thatha d+da dhadha n+na/ p+pa phapha b+ba bhabha m+ma/ ṭ+ṭa ṭhaṭha ḍ+ḍa ḍh+ḍha ṇ+ṇa/ ts+tsa tsh+tsha dz+dza dzh+dzha ny+nya/ k+ka kh+kha g+ga gh+gha ng+nga*/ g.yon skor gyis/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ṭhaka sha ṣa ny+pa sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la/ dpe byad brgyad bcu'i ngo bo de rnams yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor des mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres nas rdo rjer gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ sku mdog sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin gnas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/

zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje nor bu dang*/ rdo rje rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje mgul rgyan dang*/ rdo rje gdu bu dang*/ rdo rje ska rags dang*/ rdo rje rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa mdun zhes nas/ bzhi par tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas spras pa 'dzin pa/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa dmar po'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhi pa/ lag na me tog gi mda' lnga dang*/ gzhu dang zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dkar po'i 'og tu drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa lag pa bzhi pa/ rtse gsum dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang*/ thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dga' ma dang dbu mas zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin cing gdong dman par byed bzhin pa/ de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog g.yas skor gyis ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi re re la spyan gsum gsum/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas kyis gri gug lcags kyu sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon na thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang rin po che bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa/ de ltar ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyis dbyings kyi bdag nyid can ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar dang me'i 'dab mar nas shing ser po zhes pa'i bar 'od bzhin 'don/ gsal btab pa'i yab yum gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ yum la lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ spyi bor ha/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las a las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje mtshan pa/

yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa āḥlas skyes pa'i pad+mas mtshan pa snyoms par zhugs pa hūm̐ phaṭ kyi don mngon du byas pa'i mthar 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can/ dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan par bya ba'i snod du gzigs nas shin tu dga' ba'i sgras phung po khams skye mched sogs rang bzhin gyi lhar snang ba rnams rang gi lus la bcug dwangs mar sbyangs/ de nas yum gyi nang du spros pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i lha'i 'khor lor shar ba yum gyi lus nas slar yang rang gi lus la zhugs te zla bar zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma'i nang du spros pa ma 'dres par thig le'i rnam pa so so las mi bskyod pas gtso bo byas pa'i thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams su gyur pa rim pa bzhin phyir phyung ba'i dang po mi bskyod pa dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gnyis gtso bo yab yum la thim/ don grub sogs gzhan rnams bde gshegs 'phar ma'i ling tshe nas khor yug bar so so'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ mdor na 'og bzhin mngon rtogs 'don par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor der sems can rnams la dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ a ba dhū tī brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi bha gar babs slar rnam par snang mdzad sogs de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams yab dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i gshegs ma/ sems ma/ khro mo rnams yum gyi snying gar bsdus/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar du zhu ba gsang ba'i sna rtse gnyis nas rim pas spros pas de dag la gnyis su med par dbang bskur bas 'khor lo thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can mchog gi dga' ba'i bde bas gang*/ de dag gi las kyi phung po lde k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣu k+ṣl̥ gyur pa las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga/

khams lnga k+ṣā k+ṣī k+ṣṝ k+ṣū k+ṣl̥̄ las gshegs ma lnga/ dbang po drug k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣa ra k+ṣo k+ṣa la k+ṣaṃ las sems dpa' drug yul drug k+ṣā k+ṣai k+ṣā ra k+ṣau k+ṣā la k+ṣāṃ las sems ma drug las dbang lnga/ k+ṣaha k+ṣaya k+ṣā k+ṣawa k+ṣ+la las khro bo lnga bya ba lnga k+ṣahā k+ṣ+lā k+ṣarā' k+ṣawā k+ṣ+lā las khro mo lnga ste lha so gnyis po rnams skyes bu chen po gnyis su gyur pas brgyan pa rnams phyir phyung nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ de yan dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ gtsug tor du haṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar k+ṣaḥ de las gtum mo ye shes kyi me rjes su chags pas sbar bas gtso bo yab yum gnyis bde ba chen por 'od du zhu ba las/ byams pa'i rang bzhin sgrol mas thugs rdo rje dang*/ snying rjes rang bzhin mā ma kīs sku rdo rje dang*/ dga' ba'i rang bzhin gos dkar mos gsung rdo rje dang*/ btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin spyan mas ye shes rdo rje bskul ba'i glu dag mdzad pa/ bcom ldan khyod ni sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa po// bdag cag bsrung shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod// ces bskul ba thugs dang sku dang gsung dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid rdo rje can des gsan nas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag mig 'phrul lta bur gzigs nas sems can gyi don gyi slad du slar yang skye bar mdzad pa'i phyir zla ba bzhin du zhu ba de las hūm̐ sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing bskum pa yongs su gyur pa rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de las bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo zhes nas/ yab yum rdzogs par bskyed/ rigs gsum 'god pa nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan pa zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam mo// dkyil 'khor lnga'i bdag nyid kyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du yab kyi zhal nas zhugs a wa dhū tī brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi bha gar babs pa sngags kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor du ji ltar 'god pa bzhin dbus dang phyogs mtshams su aḥ.a ā/

thams cad sngon po zhal gcig pad+ma 'dzin pa gnod sbyin bzhin/ shar sgo'i g.yon du khyab 'jug gṛ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa nam mkha' lding gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte ba/ 'dab mar nga rdo rje ma sogs mchu'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad ljang khu zhal gcig dung 'dzin pa khyab 'jug bzhin/ lho sgo'i g.yon du gshin rje grī rdo rje mas 'khyud pa ma he'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte ba 'dab mar kā rdo rje ma sogs dbo'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad sngon po zhal gcig zhags pa 'dzin pa gshin rje bzhin/ thams cad kyang gong bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi dbang po la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis gtso bo rnams rdo rje'i gdan gyis lha mo rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gnod mdzes lta bu'i shin tu sngon mos 'khyud pa'i gtsug tor can ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na dgra sta dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis sbrul zhags dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa steng gi nam mkhar mkha' lding a nī las drangs pa'i shing rta la/ shar sgor stobs po che lta bu'i 'od zer can mas 'khyud pa'i dbyug sngon can nag po zhal gcig nas sbrul 'dzin pa/ phag nag po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ lho sgor mi g.yo ba lta bu'i tsun das 'khyud pa'i 'dod rgyal dmar po zhal gcig zhags pa 'dzin pa rta dmar po bdun kyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ byang sgor 'dod rgyal lta bu'i khro gnyer can mas 'khyud pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po zhal gcig me long 'dzin pa seng ge dkar mo bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ nub sgor dbyug sngon lta bu'i lcags sgrog mas 'khyud pa'i stobs po che ser po zhal gcig rin po che 'dzin pa glang po che ser po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du gtsug tor can lta bu'i drag can mas 'khyud pa'i gnod mdzes zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang rdo rje g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

sa 'og tu seng ge rkang pa brgyad pas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ thams cad nas sham thabs can g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la khro bo rnams g.yon brkyang gis 'khyud pa sku dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs bzhi'i ka ba brgyad kyi 'og tu 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la stobs rgyud dang pad+ma nag po ce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong mas 'khyud pa shar/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po stag gdong ma dang 'ug gdong mas 'khyud pa lhor/ rigs ldan dang mtha' yas dkar po phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong mas 'khyud pa byang*/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po khyi gdong ma dang bya rog gdong mas 'khyud pa nub/ thams cad kyang sbrul mgo lnga pa nas rdo rje'i gdan/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan du zla ba/ bden bral du nyi ma/ me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams shar rtse mos 'bigs pa'i dur khrod du bse'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar khyi gdong ma nag mo/ me lha ma za ba'i dur khrod du bhe ruṇ+ḍa'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar bya rog gdong ma nag mo/ lhor ro sreg pa'i dur khrod du dom gyi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar phag gdong ma dmar mo/ lho nub mi bzad pa'i g.yul gyi dur khrod du khrung khrung gi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar bya rgod gdong ma dmar mo/ byang rul pa dang bcas pa'i dur khrod du 'bri'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar stag gdong ma dkar mo/ dbang ldan byis pa shi ba'i dur khrod du spyang gdong gi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar 'ug gdong ma dkar mo/ nub rnag gi dri'i dur khrod du seng ge'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar ce spyang gi gdong ma ser mo/ rlung sbrul gyis zos pa'i dur khrod du mig sngon gyi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar mkha' lding gdong ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhabs zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa klus 'khyud pa/ gzhan yang ma mo dang klu dang srin po dang*/

phyogs skyong ba dang zhing skyong ba dang zhing chen dang gza' dang ri bo dang me lha dang mchod rten dang rnal 'byor pa dang ro dang ce spyang dang lo dang zla ba dang zhag dang dus kyis lha rgyu skar dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang dril bu'i rna ba can dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ zhing skyong thams cad dang*/ pho nya thams cad dang*/ 'phrog ma dang*/ grub pa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhis gang ba/ thugs kyis snam bu'i kha khyer la mchod pa'i gzungs ma/ gsung la 'dod ma so drug sku la phyir 'dod ma sum cu so drug steng 'og gnas pa'i klu rgyal ba rnam rgyal dang rab gtum ma sngon po rdo rje'i mig gnyis rnams 'khod pa la thim par gyur/ oṃ su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha'i nga rgyal gzung*/ bdun pa byin gyis brlab pa'i yan lag ni/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje shugs rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa phyir 'phros/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ des ye shes pa gtso 'khor gyi lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus bsnun/ sbrul zhags kyis bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis 'jigs par byas te mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ de nas sngar bzhin lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ dag dang ye shes gcig sbyor rgyal ba mchog gi 'dus pa thugs dang chos na gcig tu sbyor// gsung dang longs spyod rdzogs pa gcig sbyor srid gsum gyis mchod sku dang sprul pa sbyor ba ste// shes bya shes byed gnyis med srid bral srid gnas 'di ni rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa bzhi// rdo rje rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid lha mi lha min gyis bstod de la 'dud// hūm̐ dang rdo rje'i phyag rgyas khro bo shes rab mthar byed kyis rdo rje thogs te dam tshig pa la gzhug baṃ dang zhags pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo gshin rje mthar byed kyis zhags pa thogs te dbyer med du bcings/

hoḥdang dril bu'i phyag rgyas khro bo pad+ma mthar byed kyis dril bu thogs te mnyes par byas/ hī dang dbyug pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyis dbyug pa thogs te ye shes pa dam tshig pa la ro mnyam par byas/ gtso bo'i mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid la hrāṃ hrīṃ hṝṃ hrūṃ hrūṃ hṝ hraḥ dpral bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon na ral gri nor bu 'dzin pa/ shes rab ma dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros/ sku rdo rjes 'dul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas slar log ste bdag nyid kyi mdun du 'khod pa la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ kā ya badz+ra dha ra/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sku'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing bkrus nas/ sku rdo rje rnams dpral bar zla ba la bcug dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni// byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni// byin rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod// ces brjod pas ro mnyam par gyur te lus sku rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ de nas mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas na pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon na nor bu dril bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ shes rab ma dang bcas pa spro ba sogs/ sku dang gsung brje ba ma gtogs sngar dang 'dra bar byas te/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ badz+ra badz+ri na/ dbang bskur la/

gsung rdo rje rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bkod nas/ sku'i gnas su gsung gi zhes bcug nas tshigs bcad brjod la/ ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ snying gar thig le sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po gyur ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon na dril bu ral gri nor bu 'dzin pa/ shes rab dang bcas spros pa sogs sku dang thugs brje ba tsam ma gtogs sngar bzhin byas nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ tsit+ta badz+rin/ thugs rdo rje rnams snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la bkod/ sku'i gnas su thugs kyi zhes pa'i tshigs bcad brjod la yid thugs rdo rjer gyur pas bsam/ thabs la rigs gsum po de nyid kyis dang*/ shes rab la lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā bsnan te rigs drug bkod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ brgyad pa dbang bskur ba'i yan lag ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis thugs dkyil gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hriṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūm̐ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ ā ā+-i ṛ' ū l̥̄ badz+ra ḍā ki n+yau badz+ra a mṛ te/ gha ṭai ra a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ swā hā/ zhes pas chu'i dbang dang*/ oṃ aṃ iṃ ṛṃ uṃ l̥/ sarba bud+dha/ badz+ra mu ku ṭaṃ/ ma ma pañtsa bud+dha ād+ma kaṃ /ban+ta yan+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas cod pan gyi dang*/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥha hā haṃ haḥphreṃ hoḥsarba pā ra mi tā ma ma badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ban+dha yan+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ces pas dar dpyangs kyis dang*/ oṃ huṃ hoḥbi dz+nyā na dz+nyā na swa bhā be ka ru ṇā pra dz+nyā āt+ma ke badz+ra badz+ra ghan+ḍai sa bye ta ra ka ra yor/ ma ma badz+ra sa twa sa pradz+nyā+o da dā tuṃ/ zhes pas rdo rje dril bu'i dang*/ oṃ a ā e ai a ra ā ra o au a la ā wa aṃ aḥsarba bo bhi satwaḥs bhār+yāḥsarba dā sarba kā ma u pa bho gaṃ badz+ra pra taṃ ma ma da dan+tu swā hā/

zhes pas brtul zhugs kyi dang*/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā sarba kro dha rā dzāḥs bhār+ya mi tri ka ru ṇā mu di u dek+ṣa sarba sa ma tā hā bhā baṃ badz+ra pūrba ga ma nā ma med dan+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas ming gi dang*/ oṃ ai waṃ pad+ma badz+ra tsih+na pradz+nyā+o pā yau man+ḍa la a bhi pa tī badz+ra su kha dz+nyā nāṃ gaṃ ma ma de bā haṃ haṃ haḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas rjes gnang gi dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pas dbang bdun rim pa bzhin du bskur bar bsgom zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sap+ta i bha ṣe ga sap+ta bhū mi prā b+to3haṃ/ zhes pas dbang bdun thob pas sa bdun thob pa'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas dbang gong ba'i don nu/ oṃ oṃ pradz+nyā+o pā yau ka la sha a bhiṣa ka med dā tāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas gsol ba btab pas/ bum dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra satwa na badz+ra ka la shā a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra satwa pu tra a tsa lā bhū mi la b+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas bum dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas oṃ āḥpradz+nyā+o pā yau gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kaṃ med da hāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gsol ba btab pas gsang dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ā badz+ra sa twe na gu h+ya a bhi ṣi ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twa yu pa ra jo na ba bhu mi la b+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas gsang dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*// de nas oṃ huṃ pradz+nyā+o bā yau badz+ra sa twa bi shwa mā ta rau pra dz+nyā dz+nyā nā a bhi ṣe kaṃ med da taṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gsol ba btab pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra sa twe na pra dz+nyā dz+nyā ne na a bhi ṣik+to dwi tā+e ya badz+ra badha ro3haṃ/ dharma meghā bhā mi la b+dhoḥhaṃ/ zhes pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas dbang gong ma'i don du/ oṃ hoḥpradz+nyā pā ya āt+ma kaṃ badz+ra sa twa mahā mu drā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me pra ya yats+tsha/

oṃ āḥhuṃ ho phaṭ/ ces gsol ba btab pas shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hoḥdharma dhā twā k+ṣa ra tsa t+rutha a bhi ṣe ka ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twe na āt+ma nā haṃ dwi tī yo dwā da sha bhū mi b+dho badz+ra sa twa mahā a+rathaḥpā ra ma a k+ṣaraḥtrai lo kya bi dza yāḥkrā la tsa kro dha gawā na a waṃ kā raḥzhes pas shes rab chen po'i dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas phyag rgya drug bcas la/ oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa k+raṇ+ṇa yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ aṃ aḥkaḍ+ya kaṇ+ṭhe badz+ra me khal badz+ra kaṇ+ṭhi ke huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ a ā pā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa kau huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nū pu re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ haṃ paṃ pañtsa a kā ra mahā shūn+ya swa bhā wa badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sarbāṃ ge bha sma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ aṃ a+radha nā rī shā ra badz+ra a+radha tsan+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭo radh+we huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ a āḥ.aṃ sarba swa re ka tri swa ra swa bhā wa badz+ra yadz+nyā+o pa ba'i ta skan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ de nas phyag rgya bzhi'i dang po las gzhan khro bo'i khyad chos yin pas 'dir mi bya'o// oṃk+ṣaḥdur dān+ta bhi ma nak+ṣa yaṃ kar byā gh+ra tsa ra ma ka ḍau huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ de nas g.yas kyi phyag rgya bca'/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kro dha badz+ra huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kh+ṭag huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra tri shū laṃ huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kar+t+ta ri huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra bā ṇa huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra aṃ ku sha huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra ḍa ma ru ka huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra mud ga ra huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra tsakra huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kun+ta huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra daṇ+ḍa huṃ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra par+shu huṃ phaṭ/ de nas g.yon gyi phyag rgya bca'/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra kha ṭa ho phreṃ phaṭ/

oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ka pā la ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra tsā pa ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra pā sha ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra rat+na ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra pad+ma ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra shaṃ kha ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra shṛṃ kha le ho phreṃ phaṭ/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra tsa tu rbad swa bhā wa brah+ma shi raḥho phreṃ phaṭ/ klu'i phyag rgya'ang 'dir mi dgos so// zhes pas nga rgyal gzung*/ dgu pa mchod bstod kyi yan lag ni/ sngar bzhin lha mo bcu gnyis sogs dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud zhes pas nga rgyal gzung*/ bcu pa ni/ dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi bdag lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye bas so// thugs kyi rnam pa'i nyi ma ma yin nyin zhag so so'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni rnam par dag rlung gi dag pas du ba la sogs rang gi snying ga'i pad+mar rtsa yi 'khor lo la gnas rnams// nyon mongs rnams kyi drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyi bdud// dung dang gaṇ+ḍi ma ṇi ljon pa dag kyang de bzhin sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis// bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis de rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub sems sogs kyis// 'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te// gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gci ba rnam par dag pa'o// lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas// khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams kyis// tsā mun+ḍi sogs thun brgyad kyis te pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod kyi// lha min la sogs nyi ma'i zla bas 'dab mar gnas rnams chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs kyis so// gsang bar mi bdag nyid 'gyur chu tshod rnams kyi klu rnams dang ni gtum mo rnams kyang rnam par dag de bzhin 'dod ma la sogs de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya bas rnam par dag skra rnams kyis ni grub pa mtha' dag ba spu rnams kyi dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs// khams gsum po thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bsgom par bya'o// de yan las rgyal mchog de nas sngar bzhin mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas hūm̐ phaṭ kyi don mngon du byas pas lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi lte ba'i rtse mor na ho yig ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gtum mo ye shes kyi me gsang gnas kyi g.yas kyi rtse mo nas 'babs pas phung po khams sogs bskul bar byed pa de rab tu 'bar bas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas lnga dang*/

oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hṝṃ hrūṃ hral̥̄ hraḥswā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags rkang pa bcu drug pa/ 'phreng ba'i sngags bdun cu pa/ lha sngags so so gzhan du bshad pa ltar man ngag bzhin bzla'o// khro bo'i bsnyen pa la/ bsrung 'khor gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i bar byas/ gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ zhes sogs rigs drug bkod/ byin brlab dbang bskur gyi yan lag ji lta ba la/ rgyas btab sngar gyi mthar/ oṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥhriṃ sha tra swa nga sap+ta te hra sra ngīr+gha byañdza na swa bha wa de d+ya ku la sha ta sa ra bhi ra muṇ+ḍa mā lā skan+dha a wa lam+bi ni skan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ha hi hṛ hu hl̥ pañtsa skan+dha bi shud+dha swa bhā we shi ra si ga pā la mā le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣā k+ṣi k+ṣī k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣṝ k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaḥha hā hi hī hṛ hṝ hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥsarba bi gh+na bi dā ra ta gi dza tsa ra ma pa ṭā ra dra rak+ta shra ba ta hūm̐ phreṃ/ zhes gdags pa mtshon cha 'dra/ klu'i phyag rgya/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra dza ya nā ge n+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭā mu ku ṭa ban+dha tiṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ dak+ṣaṃ badz+ra bi dza ya nā gen+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ h+yaṃ h+ya badz+ra karko ṭa badz+ra pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi na kuṇ+ḍa la yoḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ hraṃ hrā badz+ra bā su ki shaṅkha bā lau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ hwaṃ hwā badz+ra a nan+ta ku li kau me kha lā gaṇ+ṭhi ka yauḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ h+laṃ h+lā badz+ra tak+ṣa kā mahā pad+mau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nu pū ra yoḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ nga rgyal gzung*/ mchod pa mtshungs/ bstod pa gtor ma bzhin byas te rkang pa bcu drug pa bye ba bsnyen no// de nas gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo rnams dang*/ gri gug gi phyag rgyas zad par rnams dang*/

ral gri'i phyag rgyas phyogs skyong rnams dang*/ rin po che'i phyag rgyas gza' rnams dang*/ pad+ma'i phyag rgyas klu rnams dang*/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas 'byung po rnams spyan drangs shing*/ de rnams la lha mo zhal zas mas bdud rtsi 'dren par bsam pa'am/ yang na hūm̐ las ljags rdo rje sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ khro bo rnams la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ.uṣ+ṇīṣa sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bi gha n+ta ka nī la daṇ+ḍa pra dz+nyān+ta ka ṭa k+ki rā dza pad+mān+ta ka a tsa la/ ya mān+ta ka mahā ba le bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ zad par la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoṃ ā kā sha bā yu/ de dza/ ud ka pri thi wī/ sā bhi ta bh+yaḥdang*/ phyogs skyong la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ ho brah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu nairi t+ya/ pa yu/ ya ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dre/ shwa ra in+d+ra/ yak+ṣa bh+yaḥdang*/ gza' rnams la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥrā hu kā la ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ budha/ maṃ ga la/ shukra/ bṛ ha spa ti/ ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥ klu rnams la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥdza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ kar ko ṭa ka bā su ki shaṃ kha pā la/ ku lika a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+ma bh+yaḥ 'byung po rnams la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ ho/ be tā ḍa/ bi kṛ ta mu kha/ shwa/ kā ka sū ka ra/ gṛ dh+ra/ byā bh+ro lū ka dzam+bu ka ga ru ḍa/ muṣe bh+yaḥ thams cad la gsham du/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ nali paṃ/ ak+ṣa haṃ/ da dā mahe/ te tsa/ ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā raḥshi gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛ han+tu kha dan+tu/ pi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsaṃ tri p+tāḥsarba sa twā naṃ shān+t-i pu+iṃṣ+ṭa rak+ṣa ba ra ṇa gup+tiṃ kurban+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badz+ra dha ra a dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes gtor ma phul te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can// khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso// rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal zhing*// srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud// ces pas bstod/
